title: Cell offset bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $N,T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\tau<k$ and $r<2T+1$. Then $\tau(2T+1)+r<k(2T+1)$.
